caseNameFull: Konigsberg v. State Bar of California
attorneys: Osmond K. Fraenkel for the National Lawyers Guild. A. L. Wirin for the American Civil Liberties Union, Southern California Branch.

opinions.text: Certiorari, 351 U. S. 936, to the Supreme Court of California. The motions for leave to file briefs of the National Lawyers Guild and the American Civil Liberties Union, Southern California Branch, as amici curiae, are granted.
